libs.note: BH-5234: a stacked child that still carries its parent's OLD commits. mc_restack finds a rewritten parent's landed copy by patch-id and replays only the child's own commits; hold_push refuses to rewrite a branch with open stacked children; bin/unblocked-children.sh and the run-build stacked-child block wait for a parent to merge under STACK_WAIT_PARENT_MERGE; bin/pipeline-health.sh pages staleparent:<project>:<pr>. Resolved at call time with lib_env_apply stale-parent; docs/notes/2026-10-07-BH-5234-stale-parent.md.

knobs.note: off | rollouts | all | plan. When a stacked child waits for its parent to merge instead of building on the parent's open branch: off = never (pre-BH-5234), rollouts = a rollout wave child (an issue body line 'Rollout wave N of M:'), all = every child, plan (BH-6389) = rollouts plus every child whose plan has no '## Stack' section with files disjoint from the parent's diff and plan files (bin/lib/stack-wait.sh), bounded by STACK_WAIT_CAP_H; a hotfix child is exempt. rollouts restores the pre-BH-6389 behaviour. An invalid value is plan, with one line in logs/stale-parent.log. Read by sp_wait_mode.

knobs.zero_means: a rewrite push no longer checks for open children (pre-BH-5234)
knobs.note: 1 = bin/lib/hold-push.sh refuses a rewrite push (the lease is not an ancestor of what is pushed) to a branch that open PRs are based on (rc 5), or whose children cannot be read (rc 4). Read as ${HOLD_PUSH_REWRITE_GUARD:-1}.
Master switch for bin/pipeline-health.sh's stale-parent section (staleparent:<project>:<pr>). Read as ${STALE_PARENT_CHECK:-1}.
At most this many open PRs per project are fetched and judged by the stale-parent section; past it one page-cut alert names the cut. Read as ${STALE_PARENT_MAX_PRS:-30}.
How many of a branch's first-parent commits over its base are walked when looking for a fork point or stale commits by patch-id. Read by _sp_scan_max, default 20.
